qualification.details: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Candidates must hold the educational qualification specified in the vacancy table from a recognised Board/University. Only candidates who have passed the qualifying examination in the last five years (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026) are eligible. Applications of candidates who have appeared in the qualifying examination but whose results have not been declared/available as on the last date of application submission are not eligible. Candidates with a higher qualification than that specified for the post are not eligible. Only candidates who completed the qualifying examination as regular candidates are eligible to apply. Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training, are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under any organisation, or have job experience of one year or more after attaining the essential qualification are not eligible. PwBD candidates are eligible only for the designated trades as per Apprenticeship Rules, 1992. Candidates must ensure they fulfil all eligibility conditions for the apprenticeship training.

how_to_apply: Download and fill the application form available at drdo.gov.in/drdo/en/offerings/vacancies.

Mention marks obtained in the qualifying examination in percentage; if your marksheet shows CGPA, convert it to percentage as per your university's norms (this will be verified during document verification).
Only offline applications are accepted; online-only submissions will not be considered.
Send the completed, signed application to: The Director, HEMRL, Ministry of Defence, DRDO, Sutarwadi, Pashan, Pune - 411021 (Kind Attention: HRD, HEMRL, Pune).
Ensure the application reaches HEMRL on or before 28 August 2026; incomplete, erroneous, or late applications will be rejected, with no further communication entertained.
important_instructions: The selected candidate must execute a contract for a one-year training period as per the Apprentices Act, 1961, and Apprentice Rules, 1992. The training period of one year commences from the date of execution of the apprenticeship contract. Selected candidates will be informed via email with further joining instructions; no correspondence will be entertained with candidates not selected for training. If a candidate does not report by the scheduled date, it will be assumed that they are not interested, and their candidature may be forfeited without further communication. If a candidate does not fulfil any eligibility condition, or their statements/documents are found false or forged, their candidature will be disqualified/cancelled immediately. No employment (permanent/temporary/contractual) is offered at HEMRL or DRDO to any apprentice after completion of apprenticeship training, and no apprentice can claim the same. No TA/DA, accommodation, transport, or medical facilities will be provided at any stage of the selection process or during training. Selected candidates must abide by the rules and regulations framed by the Administration from time to time.

content_sections.heading: HEMRL Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Candidates must hold the educational qualification specified in the vacancy table from a recognised Board/University. Only candidates who have passed the qualifying examination in the last five years (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026) are eligible. Applications of candidates who have appeared in the qualifying examination but whose results have not been declared/available as on the last date of application submission are not eligible. Candidates with a higher qualification than that specified for the post are not eligible. Only candidates who completed the qualifying examination as regular candidates are eligible to apply. Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training, are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under any organisation, or have job experience of one year or more after attaining the essential qualification are not eligible. PwBD candidates are eligible only for the designated trades as per Apprenticeship Rules, 1992. Candidates must ensure they fulfil all eligibility conditions for the apprenticeship training.

content_sections.heading: HEMRL Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum age is not less than 18 years. Maximum age and age relaxation are as per the Apprentices Act, 1961, Apprentice Rules, 1992, and NATS 2.0 Guidelines; specific maximum age figures are not stated in the notification provided. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HEMRL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27
content_sections.text: Register on the NATS 2.0 portal. Download and fill the application form available at drdo.gov.in/drdo/en/offerings/vacancies. Mention marks obtained in the qualifying examination in percentage; if your marksheet shows CGPA, convert it to percentage as per your university's norms (this will be verified during document verification). Only offline applications are accepted; online-only submissions will not be considered. Send the completed, signed application to: The Director, HEMRL, Ministry of Defence, DRDO, Sutarwadi, Pashan, Pune - 411021 (Kind Attention: HRD, HEMRL, Pune). Ensure the application reaches HEMRL on or before 28 August 2026; incomplete, erroneous, or late applications will be rejected, with no further communication entertained.

content_sections.heading: HEMRL Apprentice Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must present originals along with one set of self-attested photocopies of: Ink-signed printout of the application Signed copy of the NATS 2.0 profile Mark sheets and certificates (original or provisional) from 10th standard to the minimum educational qualification specified for apprenticeship (12th/B.Sc/B.E/B.Tech/LibSc/B.Com/B.A/BBA/ITI, as applicable) Aadhaar Card/Photo ID proof and address proof Two recent passport-size colour photographs (6x7) SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), PwBD, and EWS certificates issued by the competent authority, if applicable Selected candidates must present originals along with one set of self-attested photocopies of: Valid Police Verification Certificate from their place of last residence and permanent address Certificate of Physical Fitness in the prescribed format, issued by an authorised Medical Officer of a Government Hospital; final selection depends on meeting the health standards prescribed in the Apprentices Act, 1961, and Apprentice Rules, 1992 Undertaking for adherence to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923 Undertaking that the apprentice will follow IT Rules and Regulations applicable to the Ministry of Defence Aadhaar-seeded bank account details for DBT stipend (passbook front page/cancelled cheque) Three recent passport-size colour photographs Any other documents communicated to the candidate at the time of selection/joining

content_sections.heading: HEMRL Apprentice Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The selected candidate must execute a contract for a one-year training period as per the Apprentices Act, 1961, and Apprentice Rules, 1992. The training period of one year commences from the date of execution of the apprenticeship contract. Selected candidates will be informed via email with further joining instructions; no correspondence will be entertained with candidates not selected for training. If a candidate does not report by the scheduled date, it will be assumed that they are not interested, and their candidature may be forfeited without further communication. If a candidate does not fulfil any eligibility condition, or their statements/documents are found false or forged, their candidature will be disqualified/cancelled immediately. No employment (permanent/temporary/contractual) is offered at HEMRL or DRDO to any apprentice after completion of apprenticeship training, and no apprentice can claim the same. No TA/DA, accommodation, transport, or medical facilities will be provided at any stage of the selection process or during training. Selected candidates must abide by the rules and regulations framed by the Administration from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. What is HEMRL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the High Energy Materials Research Laboratory (HEMRL), DRDO, Pune, to engage 50 Graduate Apprentices for one year of training under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in HEMRL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: A total of 50 vacancies are notified across 12 disciplines, including Chemical, Mechanical, Aerospace, Computer, Electrical, Electronics & Telecommunication, and Civil Engineering, as well as Chemistry, Arts, Commerce, Library Science, and Business Administration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for HEMRL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application is 28 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for HEMRL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: It varies by discipline, ranging from B.E./B.Tech in specific engineering branches to B.Sc. in Chemistry/Computer Science, B.A., B.Com, BBA, and BLIS, as detailed in the vacancy table.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HEMRL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The minimum age is not less than 18 years; maximum age and relaxation follow the Apprentices Act, 1961, Apprentice Rules, 1992, and NATS 2.0 Guidelines. Specific figures are not stated in the notification provided.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for HEMRL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates must first register on the NATS 2.0 portal and then apply offline using the form available at drdo.gov.in/drdo/en/offerings/vacancies, sending it to HEMRL's postal address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for HEMRL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Selection is by shortlisting based on academic merit, written test, interview, or walk-in interview (or a combination), subject to satisfactory document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the stipend for HEMRL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: ₹15,000 per month for all Graduate Apprentice disciplines.
